about_the_game:
✦STORY✦

An exploration-based erotic RPG about a girl with dormant succubus powers who gradually discovers her “true self” through acts of service.

To make a living, Elena begins working at the village's “House of Service.”

In this mysterious mansion, she'll spend her days providing erotic service to her master.

With each intimate experience, the succubus power hidden within her slowly awakens.

Will you guide Elena with your own hands and help her grow into a full-fledged succubus maid?

A cute and naughty exploration RPG.

A girl with no wings or tail—yet to awaken as a true succubus.

✦HOW TO PLAY✦

Your goal is to control Elena as she explores the village, engaging in erotic events to raise her stats. Awaken her powers and help her grow into a full succubus.

✦FEATURE✦

▲Feel your growth through erotic stats!
As Elena serves and experiences various events in the village, her stats will change and evolve.

▲Stress-free and smooth gameplay!
No tedious controls—enjoy exploration, conversations, and events with ease.
(Features also include objectives, key guides, and a map system.)

▲Unlock events and storylines with Succubus Points!
Collect points and enjoy erotic scenes and story progression.
(Keep doing naughty things to earn more Succubus Points!)

▲Enjoy a variety of erotic situations and scenarios!

✦CHARACTER✦

Elena — A girl who has drifted from job to job.
She arrives in the village in search of work, only to uncover a hidden truth.
A cheerful and energetic young woman.
